question.text: An investor submits a purchase application for a liquid fund at 2:00 PM on a business day with funds transferred via RTGS. Which NAV will be applicable?

answer.text: Same day's NAV since the application was received before 3 PM
The closing NAV of the day immediately preceding the next business day, because the 2:00 PM receipt misses the 1:30 PM cut-off for liquid fund purchases
Same day's NAV since RTGS provides immediate fund availability
Previous day's NAV as per liquid fund regulations

explanation.text: The Logic: For liquid fund purchases the cut-off is 1:30 PM. The 2:00 PM receipt is after the cut-off, so the applicable NAV is the closing NAV of the day immediately preceding the next business day (the source uses this precise wording rather than the shorthand "next business day's NAV"). The mode of payment (RTGS) does not override the cut-off. The Trap: Two common errors: (1) applying the general 3 PM cut-off to liquid fund purchases, and (2) using the shorthand "next business day's NAV", which is not the exact source rule for liquid/overnight funds. Note: Source: NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors) workbook, pp.190 & 192 — 1:30 PM cut-off for liquid/overnight fund purchases; for applications after cut-off with funds available, the closing NAV of the day immediately preceding the next business day applies.
